root_cause_criterion.variable: (opcode == 0x41 || opcode == 0x42 || opcode == 0x43 || opcode == 0x44 || opcode == 0x23 || opcode == c_waOp_end)
root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: opcode is one of {c_waOp_i32_const, c_waOp_i64_const, c_waOp_f32_const, c_waOp_f64_const, c_waOp_getGlobal, c_waOp_end} when o->function == NULL
root_cause_criterion.criterion: On the parser-only `Parse_InitExpr()` path where `o->function == NULL`, `Compile_BlockStatements()` must allow only the constant-expression opcode whitelist before the normal opcode dispatch runs. The vulnerable build omits that conjunct and keeps dispatching top-level parser-only opcodes that the fixed build rejects immediately.
root_cause_criterion.description: The missing root obligation is the init-expression opcode whitelist at `Compile_BlockStatements()`: each top-level parser-only opcode consumed while `o->function` is NULL must be one of the constant-expression opcodes or `end`.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The original vulnerable case violates this whitelist and still reaches `dispatch_call`. The fixed original guards earlier at the same source site on opcode `0`; the one-byte `end` attempt did not exercise the fixed protected event, and the closest genuine witness was `first_initexpr_i32const_zero_end`, which turns that first rejected opcode into `i32.const 0; end` so the fixed build executes the protected dispatch with the predicate satisfied.

nodes.state: At the vulnerable dispatch site reached from `Parse_InitExpr()`, `o->function` is still NULL, so this opcode is being evaluated in the parser-only init-expression walker rather than inside a real function compilation.
When `Compile_If()` regains control after compiling the then arm, the carried `o->previousOpcode` equals `c_waOp_else`, so the else-arm compilation path is taken.
`AcquireCodePageWithCapacity()` forms the pages-open list argument while `i_runtime` is still NULL, so the list pointer is derived from a parser-only runtime that never existed.
`RemoveCodePageOfCapacity()` immediately dereferences the same `io_list` pointer that its caller formed as `& i_runtime->pagesOpen`, producing the reported invalid read.

edges.relation: The exact pointer value formed as `& i_runtime->pagesOpen` in `AcquireCodePageWithCapacity()` is passed unchanged into `RemoveCodePageOfCapacity()` as `io_list`, where it is dereferenced.
The same parser-only runtime pointer carried through `Compile_If()` is forwarded into `AcquireCodePageWithCapacity()` as `i_runtime` on the else-block allocation path.
The nested then-arm walk stores `c_waOp_else` into `o->previousOpcode`, and `Compile_If()` later consumes that same field to decide to enter `CompileElseBlock()`.
The disallowed initializer opcode decoded at the vulnerable dispatch site is forwarded unchanged as `i_opcode` into `Compile_If()` instead of being rejected on the parser-only path.
